profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at NYSE
profile.summary: Software engineer and architect focused on building scalable, high-impact platforms. Experienced in distributed systems, backend services, and cloud-native development using Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, React, and AWS. Passionate about solving complex problems, mentoring teams, and delivering technology that improves customer experiences at scale. Actively exploring and leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering velocity, streamline workflows, and enable more efficient, data-driven solutions.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead a team of engineers in designing and delivering high-quality SaaS products.
- Drive technical strategy, architecture, and end-to-end feature development.
- Build enterprise features using a modern tech stack: Java, Spring Boot, React, Node.js, Postgres, and AWS.
- Drive adoption of Generative AI tools and architectural best practices to improve engineering productivity and development efficiency.
- Mentor engineers, and collaborate with cross-functional teams for timely product delivery.
positions.insights: Spring Framework, Open API and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Architected a multi-layer solution by replacing legacy components with Redux-managed SPAs creating modern UI screens alongside enhanced functionality and a dedicated Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) services.
- Implemented Spring Boot facade services to initially proxy requests towards the monolith, enabling smooth migration. 
- Led modernization of the iCIMS platform by providing guidance on platform-wide architecture decisions and future-state design, reducing technical debt, improving platform reliability, scalability, maintainability and user experience.
positions.insights: Spring Framework, Open API and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description: Served as a Scrum Master and Developer for the award-winning iCIMS Offer product, implementing API-First RESTful services with Swagger documentation and strong JUnit coverage. Led cross-team coordination to manage product impacts, refactored legacy components for better modularity, and delivered React UI features with full test coverage.

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description: Delivered an internal SSO dashboard as part of an Agile development program, reducing Helpdesk password-reset calls by 50%. Implemented SAML/RADIUS authentication, optimized database reliability with NuoDB, and deployed the Java web app on AWS Elastic Beanstalk.

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description: Developed a C# Outlook add-in with SOAP-based CRM integration and improved debugging through Log4Net.

projects.title: Capture, Highlight and Add Notes to Web-page - Chrome Extension
projects.description: •	Designed a Google Chrome extension that allows a user to highlight, take notes, capture a screen shot and save as a PDF/PNG for collaborative use using Google API.

projects.title: JavaScript-accessible API in Chromium Project
projects.description:
•	Developed a JavaScript-accessible API in chromium to return information about the open windows and tabs.
•	Implemented a chrome extension to use API call to display detail of all tabs & highlighted active tabs in each window.
Adapted to open source software development on the live project like Google Chrome.
